title: A Black Tulip
subtitle: From the dust he came, and to the dust he will return.

items.text: A Black Tulip

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: I've got a really bad feeling about all this.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Your wound is just a scratch, nothing serious. We'll fix you up in no time once we get back to base.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Some of our fallen comrades were still in their Zeno uniforms, lying deep in the cave.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Next to them was a knife and another body.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: With arrows drawn in blood on the wall.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Look at the wall, something's scribbled on it.
Aleksei's flashlight swings to the bloodstains on the rocky walls.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: They're directions, telling us how to navigate the cave.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: What if this is another trap!?

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: I can't hear anyone. Do you know the way through this cave, Hassan?

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: I used to. But now they've turned it into a maze.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: All these forks and newly dug nooks. I'm lost.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Guess we'll trust these arrows as a final gesture of support from our comrades.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Let's go.
They continue deeper into the cave, Aleksei supporting Hassan with one hand while holding the flashlight in the other. A soft breeze caresses their faces.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Are we getting any closer?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Yeah.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Then these marks must have been left by our own comrades. Horrifying, all this blood.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Several gruesome battles were fought here.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Our people, the enemy's people, all lay sprawled on the ground.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I heard a story once, about a tough guy who went into a maze on some island.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: He killed the minotaur down there, and then followed a ball of thread given to him by a princess to find his way out.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: And our guiding thread? The dried smears on the walls.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Let's follow them. *sigh* These markings could be signs left by comrades who couldn't break out.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Keep your ears peeled, brother Aleksei. One of them slipped away, don't let him get the drop on us.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: You can count on me.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: We saw lots of little stone statues in the cave.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Placed on chiseled pedestals, all weathered, some splattered with blood.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Kinda gave me the creeps.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: One, two, three ...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hassan counted the tags in hand, saying each name out loud.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Including our losses, sixteen souls in all.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: D**n it all.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: They will not be forgotten.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Forgotten? What difference does it make if we remember them? Will that be enough to bring them back to life?

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Once the commander gets here, we'll transport the bodies back. They will all be granted dignified funerals.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Funerals, hah. They're just shows for the living to see!

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: *spit*

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I dunno why, but Hassan was really worked up.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Meanwhile, Aleksei clammed up, and so we followed the arrows on the wall, deeper into the darkness.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: There's light up ahead.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: We came to a fork in the road. It was dark on both sides, but there was a draft blowing through.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: The marks end here.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: There was this huge statue standing there, holding a fire.
Flames flicker off the eyeless statue, casting shadows down the long, dark passage.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Left or right?

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: We could check out one side, then double back to the other.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I choose left.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: There's a draft coming from the left. Can't you feel it?
Lilya's hair flutters gently to the right.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: That could lead to an exit for all we know. Shoot, how many possible paths are there in this place?

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Can your device help us navigate through here?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I'm afraid not.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: We're close, but it's not accurate enough to give us a precise location.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Then let's go the way you suggested.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Following the path led us to a room-like space, with wind flowing through a hole above.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: There were barrels, beds, and everyday items scattered about, as if someone lived there.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: It looked like our fallen comrades had fought there not long ago. The blood was still wet on their equipment.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Seems like none of the stuff we're looking for is here.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: And what are we looking for? These comrades here are already ...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: No, it's not them, something else.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Like what?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: A pile of arcanum texts. These courageous comrades must've found what Zeno needed.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: That's why trouble found them in this cave.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Bertolt brought us here to find them. But where are they?

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Hold on. Weren't we here to save our trapped comrades?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: If they're still alive, we'll save them if we happen to get the chance.
Unfortunately, they were too late.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: If we happen to get the chance?

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: That's not what the commander said! Our priority is to save lives!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Bertolt told me these orders came from high above.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: He didn't tell us anything!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I dunno. I guess he had his reasons.
A silence falls between the three of them.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: The dead can't be saved. We got here too late.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Fine, let's find the stuff. Got any idea what they look like?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: No, but they could be books, or sheets of paper.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: And where are they hidden?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: In this cave, I guess, where our friends found them and paid the price.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Or else Bertolt wouldn't have deployed one team at the expense of another.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: The deal wouldn't be worth it.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Are our lives merely calculations of worth?!

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: I'm going to ask him about this, face to face!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: While Aleksei and I talked, Hassan quietly tended to the dead.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: More and more tags filled his pockets.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Let's look around here, Aleksei. Keep an eye on the cave entrance, there are still enemies nearby.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: He was really upset.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Fine, hurry it up. We have to report this to Bertolt, fast.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Curse those arcanists to hell.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: He muttered something unsavory, but we ignored it and continued to search for what we each needed.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: For me, that meant turning over rocks and cabinets to find the documents Bertolt wanted.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: For Hassan, it meant checking the bodies, feeling their pockets and waists for metal tags.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: What could possibly be worth risking so many lives for?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Something valuable to Zeno. That's what I was told.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Are we being thrown into this mission as pointless, expendable sacrifices, just like our fallen comrades here?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I don't think anyone is seen as pointless sacrifice.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: That would be illogical.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: This is not about being logical ...

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: He shouldn't have lied to us!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: He didn't lie.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: But he didn't tell us everything either!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Is withholding the truth the same as lying?

items.speaker: Interrogator II
items.text: The answer hinges on the objective.

items.speaker: Interrogator II
items.text: Soldiers only need to know their duty, not the reasons behind it.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I disagree.

items.speaker: Interrogator II
items.text: That's fine. You have the right to disagree and keep it to yourself; plenty of others feel the same way you do.

items.speaker: Interrogator II
items.text: But at the end of the day, people still have to follow orders.

items.speaker: Interrogator II
items.text: And these people are all Zeno's finest soldiers, and one day you too will be among them.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Is Bertolt one of them?

items.speaker: Interrogator II
items.text: Lieutenant Bertolt is one of the most important pillars of the Zeno Arms Academy today. I have complete faith in him.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I see more than that.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: It is the soldiers like Hassan and Aleksei, who risk everything at the front, that keep Zeno going.
The interrogator does not answer, but gives Lilya a look of approval.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: In the heat of my argument with Aleksei, I forgot all about Hassan.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Who could've foreseen what happened next?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: There was no one else in the cave, and Aleksei's flashlight was pointed at the way in.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I was looking at Aleksei and the darkness that was behind him.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: But then it happened, behind me.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Are these it, little comrade? They're under this comrade here! The body's still warm ...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hassan called to us and when I turned around, what I saw was something I'll never forget.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: The "corpse" was alive. Dressed in our comrade's clothes, he stuck a poisoned blade into Hassan's waist and dragged it all the way up to his throat.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: It was a terrifying wound.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: AAAHHHHH!!!

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Hassan!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Aleksei was quick. He pulled out his pistol and fired two shots.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: One through the forehead, and one through the eye. The "corpse" was now truly dead.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hassan lay flat on his stomach, gasping for air. Aleksei leapt to him and helped him roll over.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hassan ...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: He was in unbearable agony as the wound split open with alarming speed. Blood spilled out at first, then other things.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: It was a nasty stench.
The stench of death approaching.
The black and red life force of the gasping man runs down his body, soaking Aleksei's uniform.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: No, no, no!

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Hah ... hah ... What did I tell you ... about wishing you'd died ...

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Ahhhhhh!

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: D**n it, d**n it! I knew it! I was right!

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: I'm fading fast, brother.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Let me treat you, Hassan. You have to hold on, I'll fix this mess, hold on!
The young man reaches behind him, fumbles, and drops the box to the ground with a hollow thud.
He opens the white box, full of hope.
Only to find it empty.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Aleksei was so desperate to save Hassan, he forgot they'd left all the medicine behind.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: "We've done all we can. I gave the last of the medicine to the others, and now I have an empty box that can hold a lot."

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: He opened up the empty box, looking like it was the end of the world.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: I can't take it anymore ... Urghhhh!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I could not imagine his pain. His cries were more terrifying than anything I'd heard in military hospitals or field camps.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: In fact, they were more like primal, animalistic howls.
Like a bull trapped in a blazing forge, bellowing and begging for release.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hassan said that we should each save a bullet for ourselves.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: But there was no way he could lift a gun now.
The wound continues to expand.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: A ... Aleksei ... please ... don't let me suffer through this ...

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: No! We can take you back to the base, or at least to the cave entrance, and find ... find ...

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: The mountain herbs, yes! They should still be at the camp, and the commander said reinforcements are on their way ...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Even I could see that he was deluding himself.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: The man was melting. Just how was he going to get home?

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: I beg you ... brother ... make it quick ...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: He pointed shakily at Aleksei's gun.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Aleksei. If you can't do it, I will.

items.speaker: Hassan
items.text: Ah ... the "tough cookie" ... haha ... good, little comrade ...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: I reached for Aleksei's sidearm, but he brushed my hand aside.

items.speaker: Aleksei
items.text: Allow me, comrade.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Aleksei closed Hassan's eyes, putting the gun to his temple.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: He left no words, no goodbyes.
With a single shot, death claims its prey, who can no longer haunt the living with his tortured wails.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Hassan's hand went limp and fell onto the stack of papers beside him.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: He'd found the stuff Zeno needed.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: As a soldier of Zeno, Comrade Hassan had fulfilled his mission flawlessly.
TO BE CONTINUED…
